summary.text: Myriad life spring lightning is Divine Bean Palace's immortal killer move. Jade green lightning balls destroy nearby foes and grow pine trees that hold ground against regenerating battlefield terrain.

claims.text: After gaining deeper influence over Divine Bean Palace while still suppressing Qing Chou, Chen Yi activates the immortal killer move myriad life spring lightning. Divine Bean Palace shakes, sparks coil around it like dragons or snakes, and jade green lightning balls explode around the palace. Most of Fang clan’s flowery wind warriors are destroyed, and where the lightning lands on peach blossom maze’s peach trees the ground turns into jade green grassland with pine trees that root in place of the peaches. Each spring lightning ball creates one pine tree, and the sparse pine stand resists peach blossom maze’s regeneration like a reef against the sea.

Fang Di Chang judges the move links life and death, gathering destruction and creation so that peach blossom maze, Fang clan’s trump card, risks breaking if the lightning keeps planting that opposing forest. Peach blossom maze’s third variation then absorbs most of the lightning’s energy into growing peaches, slowing the attack and stalling its full effect even though it does not clear the threat. At that stage Chen Yi can influence Divine Bean Palace to use three methods: green armor vegetable garden, graft wood, and myriad life spring lightning, and Fang clan has countered all three.

A smooth activation of Divine Bean Palace’s killer move myriad life spring lightning, with jade light turning into exploding lightning spheres and then into rapidly growing trees, signifies that Fang Di Chang has control over the palace.
He later manipulates Divine Bean Palace to shoot countless jade green lightning balls at Heavenly Court Immortal Gu Houses; the explosions shake them and vines grow out to infiltrate the Houses.
